answers.problem_1: Both bowls have n cards after each completed day; no unequal counts.
answers.problem_3: Identical counts; distinct memberships, e.g. after day 1 A={2} versus A={1}.
answers.problem_4: Ordinary rule: empty A/all positive labels B. Changed rule: odds A/evens B. Neither complete limiting configuration is any finite-day configuration.

limits: Proof of the formulas and quantifier distinctions is by induction/explicit witnesses in the review; finite replays do not complete infinitely many days. Physical print fit and classroom procedure are untested.
